title: Grateful Dead Live at Assembly Hall, University Of Illinois on 1973-02-21

ai_review.summary: Good‑quality soundboard capture of a solid ’73 set with standout “Eyes of the World”, “Brown Eyed Woman” and “Stella Blue”, though occasional drop‑outs temper the listening experience.
ai_review.review: The Miller mix appears to be a high‑fidelity soundboard recording, praised by most reviewers for its clarity, even if a few note blips and drop‑outs. Musically the show is regarded as an enjoyable early‑’73 performance with highlights like “Eyes of the World”, “Brown Eyed Woman” and “Stella Blue”, plus strong vocals from Donna Jean and lively audience banter.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show positively (4‑5 stars) and describe good soundboard quality, but a minority note significant audio glitches and average playing, leading to a blended rating around 4 with medium confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Several reviewers call it a high‑quality SBD with clear mix; however, some report blips, drop‑outs and occasional muddiness that prevent an “excellent” rating.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set two is noted as shorter than typical ’73 shows but still offers solid tune selection; there are interesting jams and a teasing Truckin that leads into Eyes.

band_member_comments.Phil: Bass work is highlighted despite occasional drop‑outs; praised for keeping the groove strong.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob’s spoken comment (“Rockin your socks off”) and vocal contributions are noted positively.
